title: Estimation of Conformal Metrics
summary: We study deformations of the geodesic distances on a domain of R N induced by a function called conformal factor. We show that under a positive reach assumption on the domain (not necessarily a submanifold) and mild assumptions on the conformal factor, geodesics for the conformal metric have good regularity properties in the form of a lower bounded reach. This regularity allows for efficient estimation of the conformal metric from a random point cloud with a relative error proportional to the Hausdorff distance between the point cloud and the original domain.
